original_technical_question: Identify which novelty is usable by the evolving process rather than being only an external observer reclassification.

original_technical_question: Test whether formalized chemistry composition preserves accounting and makes new viable reactions possible.

original_technical_question: Determine whether heritable language changes create independently tested new ecological function under copy/interpretation-error controls.

original_technical_question: Test inherited interpreter changes against fixed-processor controls, viability and functional innovation under matched resource budgets.

reviewed_source_version: 2003 original accepted full 10-page ECAL LNCS 2801 paper

original_technical_question: Compare observer-defined model changes to internally embodied new executable capabilities under randomized taxonomy definitions.

critical_caveat: Theory/conceptual framework, no new experimental demonstration or universal prediction; finite computation and model-dependence restrict conclusions.
reviewed_source_version: 2016 complete original 31-page author-hosted Theory in Biosciences publication

original_technical_question: Separate evolved antiparasite function from slow-copying complexity, with matched no-parasite worlds and independent viability/lineage verification.
principal_report: Spatial Stringmol experiment examines how parasite pressure can select slower, more elaborate defensive copying strategies and frequent extinction in finite worlds.
critical_caveat: Finite twenty-run world design, fixed VM, hand-designed replicator, raw/appendix data not reanalyzed; Rstringmol package version mismatch unresolved.
reviewed_source_version: 2021 full published Royal Society Open Science main paper, including methods sections 5.1–5.4

original_technical_question: Determine how blind function tests compare with retrospectively fitted generic novelty metrics.
principal_report: Authors compare generic and system-specific novelty measures on eight long Stringmol survivor runs and warn fixed measures can miss future model-breaking outcomes.
critical_caveat: Distinct empirical or conceptual primary source; full methods not reviewed to E2; no artificial organism or wet-lab experiment performed here.

original_technical_question: Compare mechanisms rather than equating RNA wet-lab experiments with digital program evolution.
principal_report: A separate wet-lab RNA host–parasite ecology developed multiple interacting lineages over 120 rounds, providing an empirical comparator to simulated Stringmol parasite evolution.
critical_caveat: Distinct empirical or conceptual primary source; full methods not reviewed to E2; no artificial organism or wet-lab experiment performed here.

original_technical_question: Causally test organization persistence, daughter-level heredity and cross-organization compatibility without a pre-coded reproduction API.
principal_report: Authors report formation of stable lambda-calculus interaction organizations, major initial-generator sensitivity, and limited higher-order coexistence under pairwise mixing.
critical_caveat: Stable lambda-function organizations depend on chosen generator and simulator physics; no causally reproducing higher individuals established.

original_technical_question: Compare collective and component reproductive fitness and identify dependence on external propagation scaffolds.
principal_report: Separate bacterial propagule lineages favored group offspring fitness, whereas pooling propagules favored constituent cell traits; non-mixed treatment reuses the 2014 study.
critical_caveat: Non-mixed study treatment overlaps 2014; researcher-imposed group life cycle; count metapopulations as independent unit, not microcosms.
reviewed_source_version: 2020 or 2025 published main article (see bibliographic record)

original_technical_question: Distinguish heritable group development from transient clustering and founder-genotype sorting under ecological selection.
principal_report: A 24-population algae experiment found stable multicellularity in 4/12 predator-selected lines and 0/12 settling-selected lines, with successful isolates traced to two founders.
critical_caveat: 6 stable isolates come from 4 independent populations; original founder competition not tested; no causal mutation reconstruction.
reviewed_source_version: 2020 or 2025 published main article (see bibliographic record)

original_technical_question: Separate external group-selection scheduling from inherited reproductive organization and trace reused 2014 cohorts in 2020.
principal_report: Authors report bacterial group offspring fitness becoming decoupled from cell fitness under a propagule-embracing two-phase life cycle.
critical_caveat: 2014 non-mixed bacterial experiment re-used in Rose 2020; full text not examined here.

original_technical_question: Compare independent predation-selected cohort evidence with the later 2025 genotype-controlled ecology.
principal_report: Two of five predator-selected algae populations developed stable multicellular phenotypes across approximately 750 generations, absent in predator-free controls.
critical_caveat: Published biological or theoretical results not evidence of subjective consciousness or independent digital-life reproduction.

original_technical_question: Determine which inherited multi-generation group traits exceed image-level clustering under controlled selection.
principal_report: All ten settled-selected yeast populations formed multicellular snowflakes by 60 transfers; lab-imposed settling favored a clonal group life cycle.
critical_caveat: Published biological or theoretical results not evidence of subjective consciousness or independent digital-life reproduction.

original_technical_question: Distinguish evolution of new group-level traits in an existing multicellular lineage from separate unicellular-to-multicellular origins.
principal_report: A 600-round snowflake-yeast experiment reports macroscopic size and toughness in anaerobic treatment, starting from engineered clonal multicellular ancestors.
critical_caveat: Published biological or theoretical results not evidence of subjective consciousness or independent digital-life reproduction.

original_technical_question: Distinguish model-level parameter reversal from actually removing all externally supplied reproduction and patch scaffolds.
principal_report: A stochastic metapopulation model predicts that collective traits can persist after reversing selective environmental parameters, under hysteresis conditions.
critical_caveat: Scaffolding still externally supports patch/reproduction operations after model parameter reset; no novel organism implemented.

original_technical_question: Test whether composition and functional integration predict transmitted community function beyond accidental coexistence.
principal_report: Critical review argues microbial community artificial selection often lacks sufficiently faithful collective heritability; proposes functional integration, positive interactions, entrenchment.
critical_caveat: Published biological or theoretical results not evidence of subjective consciousness or independent digital-life reproduction.

original_technical_question: Measure endogenous reproductive partner delivery and persistence after externally selected propagation ends.
principal_report: Experimentally implanted bacteria into Rhizopus fungus, selected positive spore inheritance, demonstrated transferred metabolic function; symbiosis subsequently washed out after outside selection ceased.
critical_caveat: Ten sorted populations arose from ONE implanted founder; no-selection washout after 4–5 rounds; FACS sorting, implantation and spore formation preinstalled.
reviewed_source_version: published original main paper; supplemental data not reproduced

original_technical_question: Separate mutant ecological advantage from evolved joint daughter-lineage inheritance and external reproductive shortcut.
principal_report: Mathematical self-inhibition model finds ecological conditions under which a partner-binding host mutant can invade, but partner attachment and consortial reproductive assortment are prescribed.
critical_caveat: Rare attachment mutant, companion transmission and population reproduction assumed in equations; no physical or digital organism experiment.

original_technical_question: Separate ecological dependence from transmission cohesion, and control for shared phylogeny and heterogeneous fitness proxies.
principal_report: Phylogenetic analysis of 106 host-bacterial symbioses associates transmitted nutritional services and smaller vertically transmitted genomes with greater host dependence, without proving new organismal reproduction.
critical_caveat: Comparative host fitness estimates from overlapping taxa; phylogeny and fitness proxy confounds; dependence does not prove joint reproduction.
reviewed_source_version: published original main paper; supplemental data not reproduced

original_technical_question: Causally distinguish producer-specific niche creation from generic external resource enrichment, and test functional group inheritance.
principal_report: Cross-feeder-dependent maintenance of Pseudomonas morphotype diversity over ~150 generations; frequency-dependent invasion hypothesis unsupported, and matched resource-flow control missing; original 200-generation evolution dataset reused.
critical_caveat: Evolved populations are reanalysis of earlier 200-generation experiment; matched exogenous benzoate control not performed; frequency-dependence hypothesis refuted.
reviewed_source_version: published original main paper; supplemental data not reproduced

original_technical_question: Test if forced complementary reproduction can persist after stress without selecting metabolic autonomy.
principal_report: Amino-acid-cross-feeding E. coli pairs exhibit reduced adaptation under stepwise antibiotic stress versus supplemented monoculture controls and frequently regain independence.
critical_caveat: Dependence constrained antibiotic evolvability; E1 only; outcomes pertain to selected E. coli mutualists not all possible syntrophies.

original_technical_question: Discriminate recovery of one surviving component from heritable rescue of the collective under matched resource and stress effects.
principal_report: In amino-acid-exchanging E. coli mutualists under abrupt lethal salinity or PNP, over 80% of stressed populations showed recovery, in each only one partner remained through reversion to metabolic autonomy.
critical_caveat: Recovery of one partner is mutualism FAILURE, not collective evolutionary rescue; full replicate audit pending.

original_technical_question: Determine whether ecological dependence and reliable co-inheritance can be evolved separately and under which costs.
principal_report: Adaptive-dynamics theory distinguishes mutual dependence and reproductive cohesion and finds their development can have different time scales and collective carrying-capacity barriers.
critical_caveat: Theory only; mutual dependence and reproductive cohesion distinct variables; main paywalled and not audited to E2.

original_technical_question: Ablate externally imposed group founding/patch regeneration to assess what becomes truly endogenous.
principal_report: Mathematical patch-structure model proposes collective Darwinian-like birth-death selection can emerge under externally imposed dispersal and resource timing.
critical_caveat: Mathematical collective selection requires externally specified patches/resource replenishment and founders.
